lines.t: He wrote His law with holy fire I'm stoning in all harsh desire
No other gods before His throne Yahuwah reigns in Him alone
No idol carved by hand or mind No name in vain, we keep it kind
Remember rest the Sabbath day
To stop to breathe, to watch and pray
We walk in the way of Yahushua
Truth and life, a narrow door
He fulfilled the will of Torah
Love and mercy at the core
From Sinai's law to Calvary's tree
He calls us now to live and be
A light that shines, a soul set free
We walk in the way
Honor father, honor mother
Love your sister, love your brother
Do not kill or steal or lie
Let no lustful glance go by
Do not covet, do not hate
Forgive before it is too late
For every word and every deed
Reflects the faith that we believe
We walk in the way of Yahushua
Truth and life, a narrow door He fulfilled the will of Torah
Love and mercy at the core From Sinai's law to Calvary's dream
He calls us now to live and be A light that shines, a soul set free
We walk in the way We walk in the way
We walk in the way
Blessing all the meek and poor
Those who hunger thirst for more
Turn the cheek and love your foes
Pray in secret, let my ghost
Sell your wealth to feed the least
Welcome strangers to your feast
What you do for them you've done
To me the Father's risen son
They broke their bread from house to house
With joy and awe, they lived it out One in heart and one in mind
No one lacks, for love's not blind They preached the truth in boldness still
Healed the sick, obeyed His will Not just hearers, but they did
As Yahushua taught and did
We walk in the way of Yahushua Truth and life, a narrow door
He fulfilled the will of Torah Love and mercy at the core
From Sinai's law to Calvary's tree He calls us now to live and be
A holy bride in unity We walk in the way
We walk in the way No turning back, no other name
We walk in truth, we walk in flame From age to age we still proclaim
Yahushua lives, we walk His way
